PROFILE SUMMARY 
− Proven finance and operations leader with 9+ years of experience, specializing 
in financial data analysis, securities operations, and process transformation across 
global teams. 
− Assistant Vice President – Wells Fargo , leading a multi -location team of 14 
professionals, driving operational excellence, workload optimization, and 
alignment with strategic business objectives. 
− Expertise across asset and wealth management, including mutual funds trading, 
NAV calculations, trade lifecycle management, corporate actions, and retirement 
plan administration. 
− Recognized for operational excellence, implementing robust quality control 
frameworks that reduced errors by 30%, enhancing client satisfaction and 
strengthening governance.

Alteryx and Power BI to automate processes, improve efficiency, and support 
data-driven decision-making. 
− Active contributor to organizational growth , participating in strategic projects, 
project presentations, and mentoring programs that enhance team performance 
and retention.
